nodes.Name: TestApplyDelta_AdditiveNeverDropsExisting_v2324
nodes.DocComment:
The headline guarantee: proposing only additions must NEVER drop an existing
entity, and must add the new entity + new field + record the new op.

nodes.Name: TestApplyDelta_NewOnExistingEntity_Dedups_v2324
nodes.DocComment:
A model that re-proposes an existing entity must not duplicate it or its
fields — NEW on an existing entity degrades to a field merge.

nodes.Name: TestApplyDelta_RemoveGatedByFlag_v2324
nodes.DocComment: REMOVE is collected but NOT applied unless allowRemove is true.

nodes.Name: TestApplyDelta_RemoveField_v2324
nodes.DocComment: REMOVE of a single field (allowed) drops just that field.

nodes.Name: TestApplyDelta_RemoveForcesSurvivorRegen_v2324
nodes.DocComment:
Removing an entity must force every survivor into the changed set so the
shared/global files (store interfaces, main wiring) regenerate without it.

nodes.Name: TestApplyDelta_EmptyDelta_v2324
nodes.DocComment: Empty delta → no changes, no entities lost.
